rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Gypsy Soul
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2006).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2015 as 'Bellevue'.
Introduced in United States by Chamblee's Rose Nursery in 2016 as 'Gypsy Soul'.
rows.Bloom: Violet-red. Moderate fragrance. up to 70 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Glossy, dark green foliage. 7 leaflets.

Height: up to 39" (up to 100cm). Width: up to 32" (up to 80cm).
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 29,272 on 8 May 2018 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 14/999,142 on 1 Apr 2016
Inventors: Kordes; Tim-Hermann (Klein Offenseth-Sparrieshoop, DE)

"KORvuebell’ is a seedling selection which resulted from the controlled pollination of an unnamed Rosa hybrida seedling developed and owned by the same inventor, the seed parent, and Rosa hybrida ‘KORpauvio’ (U.S. Pat. No. 23,495), the pollen parent, during the summer of 2006."
rows.Notes: Christened June 16, 2015 at Baden-Baden in the context of the International Rose competition. "Bellevue" relates to a building in the park where roselovers meet annually.
